title: Microburst signature synthesizer and correlated-notify playbook for usage/cost/latency
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: We keep getting short-lived but severe 'microburst' events across usage, cost and latency signals that evade existing threshold-based detectors and produce noisy, low-signal alerts. These microbursts often originate from bursting traffic patterns (short spikes from tenant onboarding flows, CI jobs, or batch replays) and lead to false positives in paging and downstream on-call toil.

Goal: Build a microburst signature synthesizer that ingests multi-dimensional telemetry (per-tenant token counts, p95/p99 latency slices, token-per-request distribution, deployment metadata) and outputs compact signatures. Use these signatures to drive a correlated-notify playbook that groups related microbursts across metrics and surfaces a single actionable incident with contextual diagnostics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Signature generator runs in the ingestion pipeline with <150ms added latency per ingestion window.
- Correlation rules group >80% of microburst alerts into a single incident (reduces alert volume by target factor 6x in historical replay).
- Notifications include: top-k contributing tenants, top-3 correlated routes, immediate mitigation suggestions (rate-limit toggle, model-fallback, burst window recommend).
- Integrations: Console incident UI links, Slack alert channel templating, automated runbook suggestions for on-call team.
